about: Jeremy A. Sitcoff is an attorney providing legal services covering Insurance Coverage, General Litigation and Appellate.

Jeremy Sitcoff, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Illinois Chicago School of Law. He graduated in 1997. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1998.
